name: DEV Shader Override Probe
summary: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Replaces the HDR compose shader with a magenta-tinted copy (runs F, T12).
description: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Never publish this mod. Ships content/rendering/programs/shaders/hdr/compose.fs, a copy of the base file with a strong magenta tint, to test whether a mod can override a base shader (at load, or after AltGr+R in debug mode). Enable it only for that test, together with DEV Photo Quality Probe (T12 checks it is active). See plans/square_photo_quality_probe/TESTING.md "Runs F".
